zh.name: ChatGPT
zh.description: OpenAI 的 AI 助手，当前最强模型：GPT-6 Astra；DevDay 发布的 GPT-6.1 Sol 与 GPT-6 Luna 将 API 价格下调约 50%（Sol $2/$10、Luna 输入 $0.10 起每百万 token），消费端额度内免费用。核心差异： 持久记忆和用户画像 —— 跨会话记住偏好、续聊最自然；通用能力最均衡，适合日常、编程和创意写作。 2026 年 10 月 7 日起，GPT-6（Sol/Luna）与 Intelligent UI 开始向全球所有 ChatGPT 用户推出：付费用户默认由 GPT-6 Sol 驱动，Free/Go 用户由 GPT-6 Luna 驱动，回复可自动渲染交互式图表、表单和可视化界面。 1.更多介绍 2.开通ChatGPT订阅经验

zh.name: 豆包
zh.description: 字节跳动的 AI 助手，当前旗舰：Doubao-Seed-2.1 Pro（Pro 最新快照 260915）；滚动迭代的最强版本为 Doubao-Seed-Evolving（用户无感迁移）。核心差异： 字节生态入口 + 多模态交互 —— 集成搜索、语音、音乐等能力； 2026-08 推出办公 Agent「豆包工作」：虚拟桌面操作电脑、飞书上下文打通、200+ 技能与连接器、多 Agents 并行协作。在桌面端下载并登录豆包工作，即可免费领取 30 天订阅权益。更多介绍

zh.name: Claude
zh.description: Anthropic 研发的 AI 助手，当前最强模型：Claude Fable 5.1（公开版）/ Mythos 5.1（可信访问）； 9 月 22 日发布的 Claude Opus 5.5（5.5 家族首款）在大多数任务上媲美 Fable 5.1，成本低约 40%，Sonnet 5.5 于 9 月 28 日推出；10 月 7 日 Haiku 5.5 发布：输入 $0.10/百万 token、输出 $0.50/百万 token（≤100k prompt），价格约为 Haiku 4.5 的 1/10、Sonnet 5.5 的 1/20，同时 Sonnet 5.5 cache read 降价 50%，agentic 任务成本再降约 20%。核心差异： Cowork 模式把 AI 从“聊天机器人”变成可拉取数据、生成 Excel 预测模型并执行工作流的代理；在编程、长上下文、安全性和企业场景上最强。 更多介绍

zh.name: Gemini
zh.description: Google 的 AI 助手，结合原生多模态、Deep Research 和 Google Workspace 集成。Gemini 4 Argon 已通过 API、AI Studio 和 Gemini Enterprise 开放，Google AI Pro/Ultra 订阅用户可在 Gemini App 使用；100 万 token 预算由输入和输出共享。Gemini 3.8 Flash 仍适合追求速度的任务；Fairwind 另向受信任的网络防御方提供受控访问。Gemini Spark 可跨 Gmail、Calendar、Tasks 执行后台任务。 更多介绍

zh.name: 通义千问
zh.description: 阿里云的 AI 助手，当前最强模型：Qwen3.8-Max（8 月 3 日 GA；Qwen3.8-27B 开源权重于 8 月 14 日发布）。核心差异： 开源权重 2.4T MoE + 长链路 Agent 推理 —— 支持 100 万超长上下文、原生多模态和深度研究。

zh.name: 腾讯元宝
zh.description: 腾讯的 AI 助手，当前最强模型：混元 Hy4 preview（2026 年 8 月发布并开源，1M 上下文）。核心差异： 混元 + DeepSeek 双模型可切换；依托腾讯生态，适合中文搜索和内容创作。

zh.name: DeepSeek
zh.description: DeepSeek 的 AI 助手，网页端、App 和 API 已更新为 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017。主打低成本推理、编程与智能体任务，支持原生多模态理解，模型权重采用 MIT 许可。此次更新重点改善从零构建完整项目的能力，并缩短任务耗时和输出长度；模型价格与 deepseek-flash 调用名不变。评测提升来自官方披露，实际表现取决于任务及运行框架。

zh.name: 月之暗面的 Kimi Chat
zh.description: Moonshot AI 的 AI 助手，当前最强模型：Kimi K3。核心差异： 2.8T MoE + 100 万 token 超长上下文 —— 面向软件工程、知识工作和深度推理。

zh.name: 智谱AI
zh.description: 智谱 AI 的 AI 助手，当前最强模型：GLM-5.3（2026 年 8 月发布）；同步提供 GLM-5.3-Flash（原生多模态，MIT 开源权重，100 万 token 上下文），编程与 Agent 能力接近 Claude Opus 4.8，价格大幅降低。核心差异： Agentic 编程、仓库级分析、网络安全与长上下文推理。

zh.name: Minimax
zh.description: MiniMax 的 AI 助手，当前最强模型：MiniMax-M3。核心差异： 长文本 + 多模态 Agent —— 支持超长上下文和语音/文本混合交互，适合内容创作和复杂任务。

zh.name: Grok
zh.description: SpaceXAI（原 xAI）的 AI 助手，当前最强模型：Grok 4.7（2026 年 9 月 21 日发布；主打编程与知识工作，500K 上下文，支持文本与图像输入）。核心差异： 实时 X 数据访问 —— 可直接调用 X 帖子作为信息源，实时新闻和事件跟踪能力强。

zh.name: Meta Muse
zh.description: 🌱 Meta 的个人 AI 智能体，可代办差旅、购物、表单和邮件日历任务，在隔离虚拟机中执行，敏感操作需用户确认。Muse Wonder 计划优先向 Muse 订阅用户推出；开发者已可通过 Meta Model API、Muse Code 使用 Wonder，Wonder Full 则面向 Muse Code 订阅用户。服务按地区向成年人开放，提供免费和付费方案，具体可用范围以官网为准。 更多介绍

zh.name: Jev
zh.description: 🌱 TypeSafe AI 推出的"System One"决策模型（当前为 early access）——不生成任何文本，只通过三类原语（Choice/Score/Noul）返回带校准概率的类型化答案，底层采用 RLCD 训练使置信度与实际正确率对齐。官方称结构化任务上比前沿大模型快 20-200 倍、成本低至 1/40； 输入 $0.042/百万 token，输出免费，延迟 70-500ms。注意：性能数字为官方口径，尚无第三方验证。更多介绍

zh.name: SemIf（原名 OpenJev）
zh.description: 🌱 MIT 许可的独立开源项目（官方声明与 Jev / TypeSafe 无关联），把「运行时语义决策」做成一次前向即可读出的概率接口：不训练、不微调，用冻结的 Qwen3.5-4B 直接读取各选项概率，不生成任何文本、无需 JSON 解析——面向 agent 的小决策（路由、重试、证据是否成立）。21 个是非判断：直接读概率中位 1.02s，逐字生成 JSON 需 5.33s（约 5.2 倍）；与 TypeSafe 公开的 102 条子集一致率 84.5%（闭源 Jev 公布 88.3%）。可跑在单卡 3090、Apple Silicon（MLX/MPS）、纯 CPU（llama.cpp），也有免 waitlist 的纯浏览器 WebGPU demo。

zh.name: OpenAI Decisions API
zh.description: OpenAI 专用决策端点 POST /v1/decisions（公开测试版），基于 gpt-6-luna 返回类型化答案：predicate（0–1 概率）、choice（选中值 + 各选项概率）、score（有序等级的概率加权均值）。输入 $0.10/百万 token，缓存读写与输出均免费；官方称比 Responses API 同调用快约 10 倍。

zh.name: Microsoft-Decision-1
zh.description: 微软基于 Qwen3.5-9B 后训练的快速决策打分模型，不生成文本，直接返回固定选项的校准概率。支持是非、多选、评分等场景，32K 上下文；通过 Microsoft Foundry 与 OpenRouter 调用，输入 $0.042/百万 token，输出免费。

zh.name: Cloudflare Clef
zh.description: Cloudflare Workers AI 上的决策模型族。clef-omni（30B MoE / 3B 激活）支持文本、图像、音频、视频多模态输入；clef-flash 针对低延迟打分优化，输入 $0.038/百万 token。上下文窗口 64K（flash 为 24K）。

zh.name: Kimi K3
zh.description: 月之暗面旗舰开源权重模型，全球首个 3 万亿参数级开源模型，把接近前沿的能力完全开放。Modified MIT 许可；100 万 token 上下文、原生视觉理解，面向软件工程、知识工作与长文档推理。 更多介绍

zh.name: DeepSeek 模型系列
zh.description: DeepSeek 面向推理、编程和智能体任务的开放权重模型系列。当前 V4 系列采用 MIT 许可，支持商用与自部署；V4.1-Flash-1017 支持原生多模态理解、100 万 token 上下文，改善完整项目开发能力与任务执行效率，另有 V4-Pro。历史版本 R1（推理）和 V3（通用 MoE）保留供研究及既有部署使用。 更多介绍

zh.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
zh.description: 智谱开源（MIT）的原生多模态 MoE 模型，支持 100 万 token 上下文；综合智能指数与 Claude Opus 4.8 持平，API 价格约为其 1/40。

zh.name: Gemma 4
zh.description: Google 基于 Gemini 架构的开源权重模型系列——把 Gemini 级能力做成 2B–31B 的可部署尺寸，覆盖端侧到服务器场景。原生视觉/音频、最高 256K 上下文，多语言支持好。

zh.name: Muse Glimmer
zh.description: Meta 开源的 300 亿参数多模态本地智能体模型，Apache 2.0 许可。支持文本/图像输入、工具调用和 4-bit 量化，可在消费级显卡本地运行。由 Muse Spark 蒸馏而来。

zh.name: Muse Spark Open
zh.description: Meta 的开放权重多模态模型，面向编程和长程智能体任务，支持 100 万 token 上下文。可通过多种推理引擎本地部署，官方展示两台各 512GB 统一内存的 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 配合 MLX 运行，硬件门槛仍较高。采用有限商业条款的 Muse Model License，并非 MIT 或 Apache-2.0；部分商业 API 转售需另行签约，也可通过合作平台调用托管 API。
zh.fee: 权重免费／API 付费，商业许可有限制

zh.name: Llama 4
zh.description: Meta 开源多模态模型系列——生态与部署支持最成熟的选择。MoE 版本从 Scout（1000 万 token 上下文）到 Maverick（400B 总参 / 17B 激活）；支持文本与图像输入。

zh.name: Mixtral-8x7B
zh.description: 法国 Mistral AI 开源的稀疏专家混合模型（SMoE），开放权重——推理快、同尺寸质量高，是其时代默认的开源选择（注意：官方推理库 mistral-inference 已于 2026 年上半年归档为只读，实际部署建议 vLLM / SGLang / llama.cpp） 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2401.04088.pdf 论文主页：https://mistral.ai/news/mixtral-of-experts/

zh.name: grok-1
zh.description: 马斯克 xAI 公司开源的大语言模型（Apache-2.0）——最早开放的前沿级开源权重之一。

zh.name: Qwen3 / Qwen3.8
zh.description: 阿里云通义千问开源 LLM/VLM 系列——目前最完整的开源模型谱系，编码、多语言和智能体场景全面。Qwen3.8 新增稠密视觉语言模型（图像/视频输入）和低成本高吞吐的 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next。

zh.name: ChatGLM2-6B
zh.description: 中英双语对话模型 ChatGLM-6B 的第二代版本

zh.name: Phi-4
zh.description: 微软开源的小型语言模型（SLM）系列——以小体积、高效部署见长，覆盖端侧与云端场景。包含通用、推理、多模态和视觉版本（如 Phi-4-mini、Phi-4、Phi-4-multimodal、Phi-4-reasoning-vision）。

zh.name: LMArena (Chatbot Arena)
zh.description: LMArena（原 LMSYS Chatbot Arena，2026 年更名 Arena）是一个用于大语言模型评估的众包开放平台，源自加州大学伯克利分校 SkyLab 的 LMSYS（与斯坦福、UCSD、CMU、MBZUAI 多校合作）。收集了超过 1,000,000 次人类成对比较，用 Bradley-Terry 模型对 LLM 进行排名，并以 Elo 标度显示模型评级。 B站视频：量子位/1v1单挑90万轮之后，最强大模型是…… 更多介绍

links.label: 量子位/1v1单挑90万轮之后，最强大模型是……

zh.name: Artificial Analysis
zh.description: Artificial Analysis 是由 Micah Hill-Smith 与 George Cameron 创办的独立第三方平台，提供 AI 模型和服务商比较及基准测试，帮助用户在选择 AI 模型和服务提供商时做出明智决策。 平台提供多种流行 AI 模型的比较数据，包括 OpenAI 的 GPT-4、Meta 的 Llama 4 和 Anthropic 的 Claude 系列，涵盖了响应速度、延迟和成本等性能指标。

zh.name: LiveCodeBench
zh.description: LiveCodeBench 是一个全面且无污染的 LLM 代码评估基准，由 UC Berkeley、MIT、康奈尔联合推出，并持续收集新的问题。LiveCodeBench 尤其关注更广泛的代码相关功能，例如自我修复、代码执行和测试输出预测，而不仅仅是代码生成。

zh.name: StructEval
zh.description: StructEval 是由滑铁卢大学领衔的 TIGER-AI-Lab 发表于 TMLR 2025 的评测基准与公开排行榜，用于评估 LLM 的结构化输出生成和转换，包含 2,035 个样例和 18 种文本及可渲染格式，并采用格式专用的结构与视觉检查。

zh.name: LLM Stats
zh.description: LLM Stats 是由 Jonathan Chavez 与 Sebastian Crossa 创办（Y Combinator 孵化）的独立综合性 LLM 排行榜，使用每日更新的开源社区数据，从能力、价格、速度和上下文长度等维度基准测试与对比 API 模型。

zh.name: ModelCap
zh.description: ModelCap 是独立平台，发布实时 AI 模型排名（ModelCap Index），仅聚合具名公开来源——SWE-bench、ARC-AGI、BFCL 等基准榜、Arena 评分与供应商价格—— 每个模型附证据等级与分数区间，并提供分基准排行榜、模型头对头对比、供应商定价页与 CC BY 4.0 JSON/CSV 数据集。

zh.name: Price Per Token
zh.description: 由 Alex Ellman 开发的 LLM API 定价对比工具，覆盖 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等 200+ 模型，内置 token 计数、成本计算器与基准对比。

zh.name: BenchGecko
zh.description: 独立第三方 AI 模型基准测试排行榜，跨供应商定价对比，AI经济仪表盘。追踪数千个AI模型、128个评估基准、数百个供应商。提供免费API和开放数据集。

zh.name: llmrun
zh.description: llmrun 是一个免费网站，可查看你的显卡、Mac 或迷你主机能跑哪些开源大模型：各量化所需显存与预估速度（tok/s），并提供基于公开基准（Epoch AI、LiveBench、SWE-bench、MMLU-Pro）、用 2PL IRT 拟合的综合评分，方法论公开。

zh.name: The Aggregate
zh.description: 独立、免费的大模型排行榜：把公开基准测试排行榜整合为每日更新的统一排名，用稳健的 IRT 模型将所有模型放在同一 Elo 刻度上并给出标准误；每个分数都链接到原始榜单，可对任意两个模型做头对头对比，并提供无需密钥的免费 MCP 服务器。

zh.name: Jev Decision Index
zh.description: Hugging Face Space，跟踪 TypeSafe Jev（System One / RLCD）的开源复现与替代方案。包含 Decision Index 排行榜（按结构化决策基准给模型打分）和 News 面板（汇总解码技巧、扩散式方法和训练决策头等实现）。

zh.name: Claude Code
zh.description: Anthropic 推出的 AI 编程智能体。支持终端 CLI、VS Code/Cursor/JetBrains IDE 插件、桌面 App 和 Web， 基于 Claude 系列模型，具备长上下文代码理解、跨文件编辑、shell 命令执行、MCP 扩展、Skills/Hooks/子代理、CLAUDE.md 项目规则与自动记忆能力；支持 Remote Control，可从手机或浏览器继续本地会话。 更多介绍 对比

zh.name: Codex
zh.description: OpenAI 推出的开源（Apache-2.0）终端编程智能体，使用 Rust 编写。支持终端 CLI、VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf 等 IDE 扩展、Codex App/桌面体验及 Codex Web 云端任务； 可直接理解并修改代码，内置内核级沙箱、MCP、Skills/Plugins/Hooks、子代理，通过 ChatGPT relay 在手机/桌面/Web 之间同步活跃会话，并支持 Remote SSH 连接远程环境。更多介绍 对比

zh.name: WorkBuddy
zh.description: 腾讯推出的全场景 AI 智能体桌面工作台（“腾讯龙虾”）。支持自然语言派活，自主规划并操作本地文件、Office、文件夹完成复杂办公任务；可接入微信、企业微信、QQ、飞书、钉钉，数据支持本地运算。 免费版每月赠送 500 积分（新用户另有额外赠送额度），轻度使用完全够用。更多介绍

zh.name: Kimi Code
zh.description: 月之暗面推出的 AI 编程智能体 CLI，在终端中运行。 可读取和编辑代码、执行 shell 命令、搜索文件、抓取网页，并根据反馈规划下一步。支持视频输入、AI 原生 MCP 配置、子代理、生命周期钩子以及 ACP 编辑器集成（Zed、JetBrains）。更多介绍 对比

zh.name: Manus
zh.description: 🌱 Manus 是一款行动引擎——不仅提供答案，还能执行任务、自动化工作流程。2026 年 9 月发布全架构重构的 Manus 2.0（Cascade 框架、常驻云电脑）及个人智能体应用 Cue。 更多介绍

zh.name: DeepSeek Harness
zh.description: 🌱 DeepSeek 开源（MIT）的 agent harness（智能体运行时）：提供 CLI 与本地 Web UI，基于 Cordis 的“一切皆插件”架构，内置 40+ 子包（LLM、MCP、沙箱、Skills、子代理、Web、Shell 等）。当前为开发者预览版，预计会有不兼容更新。 更多介绍

zh.name: Trae
zh.description: 🌱 字节跳动推出的 AI 编程与工作智能体产品族。包含 Trae Code（终端 CLI Agent）、Trae IDE（含 IDE Mode 与 SOLO Mode）、Trae Work（Web/桌面/移动工作空间，支持 Code Mode 与 Work Mode 及云端任务）。 覆盖从终端到 IDE 再到云端工作区的完整链路，支持自定义 Agent、MCP、规则与多模型。 更多介绍

zh.name: OpenDots
zh.description: 🌱 CopilotKit 开源的 AI 智能体工作空间模板（OpenAI Dots 的自托管替代）。可为每个 Dot 配置独立计算机、浏览器/文件/终端权限、MCP 工具与 Slack/通话集成；支持 Spaces 文档协作、后台任务、人工审批后保存。需自部署并接入 CopilotKit Intelligence 与 OpenAI 兼容模型。 更多介绍

zh.name: Pi
zh.description: earendil-works 开源（MIT）的自扩展 AI 编程智能体。模块化 Monorepo：精致的交互式 CLI、统一多厂商 LLM 层与插件化架构；强调供应链安全加固与沙箱化执行（Gondolin、Docker、OpenShell）。

zh.name: Qoder
zh.description: 阿里云推出的 AI 智能编程助手与智能体产品族，主打“自主编程新范式”。通过多智能体协同、长时委派执行、记忆与知识引擎，与代码库和工具链深度连接，围绕真实任务持续完成理解、规划、执行、验证与迭代。 产品包括 Qoder Desktop（自主开发工作台）、QoderWork（本地 AI 工作搭子）、QoderWake（数字员工）、Qoder CLI（终端原生编程搭档/智能体引擎）以及面向企业的 Cloud Agents 云端托管平台。 对比

zh.name: Antigravity
zh.description: Google 的智能体编程平台，提供桌面 App、IDE、终端 CLI（agy）和 SDK。支持 Gemini 4 Argon、Gemini 3.8 Flash，以及 Claude、GPT-OSS 等第三方模型，具体访问权限取决于订阅方案。Editor / Manager 双视图可协调多个自主智能体，内置浏览器、终端、可核验 Artifacts（计划、截图、录屏）、子代理、Hooks 和定时任务。

zh.name: Devin
zh.description: Cognition 的自治 AI 软件工程师——「派工单」模式的开创者：通过 Slack、Jira 或 Linear 把任务派给 Devin，它自主规划、在云端沙箱写代码、跑测试并异步提交 PR，可并行多个会话。免费档；Core $20/月起（按 ACU 计量）；Team $500/月。Windsurf 已并入为 Devin Desktop（2026 年 6 月）。

zh.name: Grok build
zh.description: xAI 推出的基于终端的 AI 编程智能体，开源且使用 Rust 编写。以全屏、支持鼠标交互的 TUI 形式运行，能理解代码库、编辑文件、执行 shell 命令、搜索网络并管理长时间运行的任务。支持交互式、无头（脚本/CI）以及嵌入 ACP 编辑器等模式，内置 MCP 服务器、技能、插件、钩子和沙箱。

zh.name: browser-use
zh.description: 开源 Python 库，使 AI 智能体能够控制网页浏览器。支持自然语言任务执行、DOM 提取、表单填写、多步导航，并通过简单 API 与任意大模型集成。适用于构建网页智能体、自动化测试和数据提取工作流。

zh.name: Obscura
zh.description: 开源（Apache-2.0）的 Rust 无头浏览器引擎，面向 AI 智能体与网页抓取。通过 Chrome DevTools 协议直接替代 headless Chrome，兼容 Puppeteer/Playwright：内存占用约 30MB、启动瞬时，内置 stealth 反指纹与追踪拦截模式。

zh.name: Cua
zh.description: 面向计算机使用代理 (Computer-Use Agents) 的开源基础设施。提供可在 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Android 上运行的沙箱、驱动和 SDK，使 AI 能够像人类一样控制桌面并执行任务。

zh.name: AX
zh.description: Google 开源的 agentic 编排运行时，定位"Agent 时代的 Kubernetes"。通过声明式 YAML 清单（Workspace、Task、Model）定义任务，沙箱隔离执行，支持 CPU/内存限制、ax suspend/resume 暂停恢复和 SSH 调试；单集群设计目标支撑十亿级自主 Agent 工作负载。尚处早期，正式发布前可能有破坏性变更。 更多介绍

zh.name: ARTEMIS
zh.description: Google 开源框架，将自然语言指令转换为可靠的 Android 端自动化：跨应用任务执行、多模态目标定位，Flash（快速反应）/ Pro（多智能体规划）双执行模式。提供 Web 控制台、MCP Server、Python SDK 和 CLI，可与 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体集成。 更多介绍

zh.name: OpenClaw
zh.description: 开源的自托管 AI 智能体，在本地运行并自主执行任务：连接 WhatsApp、Telegram、Slack、Discord 等消息平台，控制浏览器、访问系统、持久记忆。现由独立的 OpenClaw Foundation 维护（OpenAI 继续支持）；是增长最快的开源项目之一。

zh.name: OpenWorker
zh.description: 吴恩达（Andrew Ng）开源的本地优先桌面 AI 同事。以交付完整工作成果（文档、Slack 回复、日程更新、报告）为目标，而非仅提供聊天回答。支持 25+ 应用连接器、MCP 协议，可接入自有 API Key 的多种模型（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen、Ollama 等），数据和凭证本地存储。

zh.name: autoresearch
zh.description: Karpathy 开源的自动化 AI 研究助手。它能够自主提出假设、修改训练代码并运行实验，通过不断迭代来寻找性能提升方案，是专为机器学习研究设计的自主 Agent。

zh.name: ml-intern
zh.description: 由 Hugging Face 开发的开源自主 AI Agent，定位为专业机器学习工程师。它能够处理端到端的 ML 生命周期，包括研究论文、编写代码、运行实验以及将模型发布到 Hugging Face Hub。

zh.name: Multica
zh.description: 开源托管代理平台，将 AI 编码代理（Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Gemini, Pi, Kimi, Kiro CLI 等）作为“一等公民”队友集成到开发团队中。支持任务分配、进度跟踪、技能复用，本地守护进程可自动检测已安装的 Agent CLI。

zh.name: Paperclip
zh.description: 开源 AI 智能体编排平台，将 AI 运营建模为公司组织。可定义组织架构、汇报关系、预算和治理策略，让智能体在该结构内自主工作。支持 OpenClaw、Claude Code、Codex 等智能体后端。基于心跳机制执行，具备成本控制和审计追踪。

zh.name: Symphony

zh.name: QM
zh.description: YC 开源的面向企业组织的 multi-agent harness，运行在 Slack 和 Web 上。以 scope（作用域）为每个员工、项目、频道隔离记忆、文件、凭据与权限；核心为 headless 架构，模型和 harness 可替换，支持 Docker/Fly/AWS 自托管。

zh.name: Buzz
zh.description: Block 开源的可自托管人机协作工作空间，人类与 AI 智能体共享同一个房间。智能体拥有独立密钥和审计轨迹，可打开仓库、提交补丁、审查代码、运行工作流、编辑画布、加入语音讨论等。基于 Nostr relay 构建，每条消息和操作都是签名事件。

zh.name: deer-flow

zh.name: Orkas
zh.description: 开源、本地优先的多智能体 AI 桌面客户端。Commander 会拆解目标，并协调拥有独立技能和记忆的专职 Agent 并行或串行工作。支持自带模型服务和本地模型端点，也可调用 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、OpenCode 和 Hermes。跨平台支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。

zh.name: Orca
zh.description: 跨平台 Agent Development Environment（ADE），用于编排并行的 AI 编程智能体舰队。可在独立 git worktree 中并排运行 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Pi 及任何 CLI 智能体，对比输出并合并最优解。 支持 Mobile Companion、终端分屏、Design Mode（捕获 Chromium UI 元素）、GitHub/Linear 集成、SSH worktrees、AI diff 批注和 Computer Use。

zh.name: Paseo
zh.description: 🌱 开源的 Agentic 开发环境，在一个界面中统一接入 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、OpenCode、Pi、Antigravity、Muse Code 等编程智能体。支持多代理在独立 worktree 中并行运行，内置编排、编辑器、终端、diff、PR、浏览器与插件系统；可自托管、无遥测，覆盖桌面、移动、Web、CLI，并提供 TypeScript SDK。 更多介绍

zh.name: AgentsMesh
zh.description: AI Agent 工作流平台。可自托管的远程 AI 工作站（AgentPods），提供 PTY 沙箱 + git worktree 隔离、基于频道和 pod 绑定的多智能体协作、内置看板（MR/PR 集成）、每 pod 独立 MCP 服务器。支持 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Aider、OpenCode。

zh.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
zh.description: 微软开源（MIT）的 AI 智能体与多智能体工作流框架，也是已归档 AutoGen 的官方推荐后继项目。支持 Python、.NET 和多家模型服务，提供图式编排、检查点恢复、人工审批与 OpenTelemetry 可观测性，适合需要持久执行、可审查工作流的开发团队，可从本地开发扩展到云端部署。框架免费，模型和托管费用取决于所选服务。

zh.name: msitarzewski/agency-agents

zh.name: ECC

zh.name: CC Switch

zh.name: mu

zh.name: Termux

zh.name: AI-Codereview-Gitlab

zh.name: Cate
zh.description: 开源桌面 IDE，基于无限缩放画布。可以把 Monaco 编辑器、xterm.js 终端、内嵌浏览器和 Claude Code 智能体面板自由排布在可缩放的空间里，代替传统的窗口和标签页。面板支持浮动、停靠或分离为独立窗口，布局按项目自动保存。基于 Electron 构建，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。

zh.name: CLIProxyAPI
zh.description: 代理服务器，将各类 AI CLI 工具和订阅（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Grok 等）通过 OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex 兼容的 API 接口暴露出来。支持 OAuth 登录、流式/WebSocket 响应、函数调用、多模态输入，以及跨多账号的负载均衡。

zh.name: Markstream
zh.description: 面向 AI 对话界面的开源流式 Markdown 渲染器家族，可处理未闭合 Markdown 并平滑展示 token 流。提供持续维护的 Vue 3/Nuxt、React/Next.js、Svelte、Angular、Vue 2 及框架无关的 parser/core 包，并支持 Mermaid、KaTeX、代码高亮、安全 HTML 与 SSR。

zh.name: Cortex

zh.name: REA
zh.description: 🌱 开源 MCP 工具集，让 AI 编程 Agent 变成逆向工程助手。REA 把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Grok Build 等代理接入本地分析引擎，可 inspect 原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron、.NET 程序集、网站、Android APK、固件和网络抓包。Agent 在无源码的情况下分析目标功能，获得带证据的结论，并为你的项目重建可运行实现。项目为 MIT 许可，分析引擎在本地运行。 更多介绍

zh.name: PentAGI
zh.description: 开源、可自托管的多智能体渗透测试系统：用自然语言描述目标与意图，专职 Agent 自主规划，在隔离的 Docker 沙箱内运行 nmap、Metasploit、sqlmap 等 20+ 专业工具，最终输出带利用步骤的漏洞报告。支持 10+ 云端 LLM 供应商，也可接 Ollama/vLLM 本地模型；研究结论与成功路径存于 PostgreSQL + pgvector，可选 Neo4j 知识图谱，另有 REST/GraphQL API 与 Web UI，并提供交互式安装器与 Docker Compose 部署。自托管版免费（MIT）；企业版增加 Agent 档案、插件/MCP 与实时攻击链视图。仅限授权测试使用。 更多介绍

zh.name: Codex Security

zh.name: Google AI Studio

Differentiation: persistent memory and user profile — remembers context across conversations and feels the most personalized; best general-purpose assistant for coding, writing, and daily tasks. More Info

en.name: Claude
en.description: Anthropic's AI assistant. Current flagship: Claude Fable 5.1 (general) / Claude Mythos 5.1 (trusted access); Claude Opus 5.5 matches Fable 5.1 on most tasks at ~40% lower cost, Sonnet 5.5 shipped Sep 28, and Haiku 5.5 launched Oct 7 at $0.10/$0.50 per M tokens for prompts up to 100k — roughly 1/10 the price of Haiku 4.5 and 1/20 of Sonnet 5.5. Sonnet 5.5 cache reads were also cut 50%, making most agentic work ~20% cheaper. Differentiation: Cowork mode turns the chatbot into an agent that pulls financial data, builds Excel forecasting models, and executes workflows; strongest at coding, long-context reasoning, safety, and enterprise use. en.name: Gemini
en.description: Google's AI assistant combining native multimodality, Deep Research, and Google Workspace integration. Gemini 3.8 Flash remains the fast option. Fairwind provides separate controlled access for trusted cyber defenders; Gemini Spark handles background tasks across Gmail, Calendar, and Tasks. More Info

en.name: DeepSeek
en.description: DeepSeek's AI assistant, with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 available on the web, app, and API. Focuses on reasoning, coding, and agent tasks at low API cost, with native multimodal understanding and MIT-licensed open weights. The October update improves complete-project development and reduces task runtime and output length; model pricing and the deepseek-flash API alias are unchanged. Benchmark gains are company-reported, and performance varies by task and harness.

en.name: Kimi Chat

en.description: Alibaba's AI assistant. Current flagship: Qwen3.8-Max (GA Aug 3, 2026; open weights for Qwen3.8-27B released Aug 14). Differentiation: open-weight 2.4T MoE + long-horizon agentic reasoning — strong coding/deep research with 1M context and native multimodality.

en.name: Meta Muse

Muse Wonder is planned for subscriber-first rollout in Muse; Wonder is already available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, while Wonder Full is offered to Muse Code subscribers. Regional rollout for adults, with free and paid plans; check the official site for current access. More Info

en.name: Jev
en.description: 🌱 TypeSafe AI's "System One" decision model (early access) — it never generates text, returning typed answers (Choice/Score/Noul) with calibrated probabilities so confidence matches accuracy. Officially 20-200x faster and 1/40-1/400 cheaper than frontier LLMs on structured tasks; input $0.042/M tokens, output free, 70-500ms latency. Note: official figures, not yet independently verified. More Info

en.name: SemIf (formerly OpenJev)
en.description: 🌱 An MIT-licensed independent open-source project (explicitly unaffiliated with Jev or TypeSafe) that turns runtime semantic decisions into a probability readout: no training, no fine-tuning — it reads typed option probabilities directly from a frozen Qwen3.5-4B, generating no text and needing no JSON parsing, aimed at the small decisions agents make (route this, retry that, does the evidence hold?). On 21 yes/no judgments the direct readout has a median of 1.02s vs 5.33s for generating a JSON array token by token (~5.2x); agreement with TypeSafe's published 102-row subset is 84.5% (closed-source Jev reports 88.3%). Runs on a single RTX 3090, Apple Silicon (MLX/MPS), or CPU-only via llama.cpp, plus a browser-only WebGPU demo with no waitlist.

en.name: OpenAI Decisions API
en.description: OpenAI's dedicated decision endpoint (POST /v1/decisions) in public beta. Returns typed answers — predicate (0–1 probability), choice (selected value + per-option probabilities), or score (probability-weighted mean across ordered levels) — based on gpt-6-luna. Input $0.10/M tokens; cache read/write and output tokens are free. About 10× faster than the same call through Responses API.

en.name: Microsoft-Decision-1

en.name: Cloudflare Clef

en.name: Gemma 4
en.description: Google's open-weight LLM series built on the Gemini architecture — Gemini-derived quality in small, deployable sizes (2B–31B) from on-device to server. Native vision/audio, up to 256K context, and strong multilingual support.

en.name: Muse Glimmer
en.description: Meta's 30B-parameter open-weight multimodal model for local agents under Apache 2.0. Supports text/image input, tool use, and 4-bit quantization for consumer GPUs. Distilled from Muse Spark.

en.name: Muse Spark Open
en.description: Meta's open-weight multimodal model for coding and long-running agent tasks, with a 1M-token context. Runs locally through supported inference engines, including MLX on two 512GB M5 Ultra Mac Studios; substantial memory is still required. Uses the Muse Model License with limited commercial terms, not MIT or Apache-2.0: some commercial API resale requires a separate agreement. Hosted APIs are available from partner providers.
en.fee: Free weights / Paid API; license restrictions

en.name: Llama 4
en.description: Meta's open-weight multimodal model family — the safest choice for ecosystem and deployment support. MoE variants range from Scout (10M-token context) to Maverick (400B total / 17B active); supports text and image input.

en.name: Mixtral
en.description: Mixtral 8x7B, a high-quality sparse mixture-of-experts model (SMoE) with open weights — fast inference and strong quality for its size made it the default open-weight choice of its era. Note: the official mistral-inference repo was archived read-only in 2026; for deployment use vLLM, SGLang or llama.cpp. paper：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2401.04088.pdf news：https://mistral.ai/news/mixtral-of-experts/

en.name: grok-1
en.description: A large language model open-sourced by xAI under Apache-2.0 — among the first frontier-scale open-weight releases.

en.name: Phi-4
en.description: Microsoft's open-weight small language model (SLM) family — efficient small models for on-device and cloud deployment. Includes general, reasoning, multimodal, and vision variants (e.g., Phi-4-mini, Phi-4, Phi-4-multimodal, Phi-4-reasoning-vision).

en.name: LMArena (Chatbot Arena)
en.description: LMArena (formerly LMSYS Chatbot Arena; renamed Arena in 2026) is a crowdsourced open platform for LLM evals, born from UC Berkeley's SkyLab (LMSYS, with Stanford/UCSD/CMU/MBZUAI). Collected over 1,000,000 human pairwise comparisons to rank LLMs with the Bradley-Terry model and display the model ratings in Elo-scale. More Info

en.name: Artificial Analysis
en.description: Artificial Analysis is an independent third-party platform founded by Micah Hill-Smith & George Cameron, providing AI model and service provider comparisons and benchmarks to help users make informed decisions when choosing AI models and service providers. The platform provides comparative data on a wide range of popular AI models, including OpenAI's GPT-4, Meta's Llama 4, and Anthropic's Claude series, covering performance metrics such as response time, latency, and cost.

en.name: LiveCodeBench
en.description: LiveCodeBench is a holistic and contamination-free evaluation benchmark of LLMs for code, built by UC Berkeley + MIT + Cornell, that continuously collects new problems over time. Particularly, LiveCodeBench also focuses on broader code-related capabilities, such as self-repair, code execution, and test output prediction, beyond mere code generation.

en.name: StructEval
en.description: StructEval is a TMLR 2025 benchmark and public leaderboard by University of Waterloo-led TIGER-AI-Lab for evaluating LLM structured-output generation and conversion across 2,035 examples, 18 text and renderable formats, and format-specific structural and visual checks.

en.name: LLM Stats
en.description: LLM Stats, an independent, comprehensive LLM leaderboard founded by Jonathan Chavez & Sebastian Crossa (Y Combinator-backed), benchmarks and compares API models using daily‑updated, open‑source community data on capability, price, speed, and context length.

en.name: ModelCap
en.description: ModelCap, an independent platform, publishes live AI model rankings (the ModelCap Index) compiled only from named public sources — benchmark boards such as SWE-bench, ARC-AGI and BFCL, Arena ratings and provider prices — with an evidence tier and score interval per model, per-benchmark leaderboards, head-to-head model comparisons, provider pricing pages and a CC BY 4.0 JSON/CSV dataset.

en.name: Price Per Token
en.description: Compare LLM API pricing across 200+ models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more, built by Alex Ellman. Includes token counters, cost calculators, and benchmark comparisons.

en.name: BenchGecko
en.description: The data layer of the AI economy — an independent AI model benchmark leaderboard with cross-provider pricing comparison across hundreds of providers. Tracks thousands of models across 128 benchmarks, AI economy indicators, agent leaderboard, and MCP server directory. Free API.

en.name: llmrun
en.description: llmrun is a free site that shows which open LLMs fit your GPU, Mac or mini PC: VRAM needed per quantization and estimated speed (tok/s), plus a composite score fitted with 2PL IRT over public benchmark results (Epoch AI, LiveBench, SWE-bench, MMLU-Pro), with the methodology published.

en.name: The Aggregate
en.description: A free, independent LLM leaderboard that combines public benchmark leaderboards into one daily ranking: a robust IRT model puts every model on an Elo scale with standard errors, every score links to the leaderboard it came from, and any two models can be compared head to head. Also offers a free, no-key MCP server for assistants.

en.name: Jev Decision Index
en.description: A Hugging Face Space tracking open-source reproductions and alternatives to TypeSafe's Jev (System One / RLCD). Combines a Decision Index leaderboard scoring models on structured-decision benchmarks with a News tab cataloging decoding tricks, diffusion-based approaches, and trained decision heads.

en.name: Claude Code
en.description: The industry-standard AI coding agent from Anthropic. Available in the terminal CLI, VS Code/Cursor/JetBrains IDE plugins, desktop app, and web. Built on the Claude model family, it offers long-context codebase understanding, multi-file editing, shell command execution, MCP extensions, skills/hooks/subagents, CLAUDE.md project rules, and automatic memory. Supports Remote Control to continue local sessions from your phone or browser. More Info Comparison

en.name: Codex
en.description: OpenAI's open-source (Apache-2.0) terminal coding agent, written in Rust. Supports the terminal CLI, VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf IDE extensions, Codex App/desktop app, and Codex Web cloud tasks. It can understand and modify code directly, with kernel-level sandboxing, MCP, skills/plugins/hooks, subagents, and Remote SSH. Active sessions sync across phone/desktop/web via the ChatGPT relay. More Info Comparison

en.name: Kimi Code
en.description: Moonshot AI's AI coding agent CLI that runs in your terminal — stands out with native video input and first-class Chinese-language support. Reads and edits code, runs shell commands, searches files, fetches web pages, and plans next steps based on feedback. Supports AI-native MCP configuration, subagents, lifecycle hooks, and ACP editor integration (Zed, JetBrains). More Info Comparison

en.name: Manus
en.description: 🌱 An action engine that goes beyond answering questions to executing tasks and automating workflows. Rebuilt Manus 2.0 (Cascade framework, always-on cloud computer) plus the Cue personal agent shipped Sep 28, 2026. More Info

en.name: DeepSeek Harness
en.description: 🌱 DeepSeek's open-source (MIT) agent harness — a full agent runtime (CLI + Web UI) built on an "everything is a plugin" architecture with 40+ built-in packages (LLM, MCP, sandbox, skills, subagents, web, shell, etc.). Currently developer preview — breaking changes expected. More Info

en.name: OpenDots
en.description: 🌱 CopilotKit's open-source self-hosted agent workspace template (open alternative to OpenAI Dots). Gives each Dot its own computer with browser/file/terminal permissions, MCP tools, Slack/calls, Spaces document collaboration, background tasks, and human-in-the-loop approval. Requires self-hosting and connecting CopilotKit Intelligence + an OpenAI-compatible model. More Info

en.name: Antigravity
en.description: Google's agent-first AI coding platform, available as a desktop app, IDE, terminal CLI (agy), and SDK. Supports Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash, alongside third-party models such as Claude and GPT-OSS; model access depends on the plan. Editor/Manager views coordinate multiple agents with a browser, terminal, verifiable Artifacts, subagents, hooks, and scheduled tasks.

en.name: Devin
en.description: Cognition's autonomous AI software engineer — the pioneer of the assign-a-ticket model: hand tasks to Devin via Slack, Jira or Linear, and it plans, writes code in its own cloud sandbox, runs tests, and opens PRs asynchronously in parallel sessions. Free tier; Core from $20/mo metered by ACUs; Team $500/mo. Windsurf merged into Devin as Devin Desktop (June 2026).

en.name: Pi
en.description: Open-source (MIT) self-extensible coding agent by earendil-works. Modular monorepo with a polished interactive CLI, a unified multi-provider LLM layer, and a plugin architecture; emphasizes supply-chain hardening and sandboxed execution (Gondolin, Docker, OpenShell).

en.name: Grok build
en.description: xAI's terminal-based AI coding agent, open-sourced and written in Rust. Runs as a full-screen, mouse-interactive TUI that understands your codebase, edits files, runs shell commands, searches the web, and manages long-running tasks. Supports interactive, headless (scripting/CI), and ACP editor-embedded modes, with MCP servers, skills, plugins, hooks, and sandboxing.

en.name: browser-use
en.description: Open-source Python library that enables AI agents to control web browsers. Supports natural-language task execution, DOM extraction, form filling, multi-step navigation, and integration with any LLM via a simple API. Useful for building web agents, automated testing, and data extraction workflows.

en.name: Obscura
en.description: Open-source (Apache-2.0) headless browser engine written in Rust for AI agents and web scraping. A drop-in replacement for headless Chrome via the Chrome DevTools Protocol, compatible with Puppeteer/Playwright: ~30 MB memory, instant startup, and a built-in stealth mode with anti-fingerprinting and tracker blocking.

en.name: Cua
en.description: Open-source infrastructure for Computer-Use Agents (CUA). Provides sandboxes, drivers, and SDKs for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android, enabling AI to control full desktops just like a human.

en.name: AX
en.description: Google's open-source agentic orchestration runtime — positioned as "the Kubernetes for agents". Declarative YAML manifests (Workspace, Task, Model) with sandboxed execution, CPU/memory limits, ax suspend/resume and SSH debugging; single-cluster design targets billions of autonomous agent workloads. Early stage, breaking changes expected. More Info

en.name: ARTEMIS
en.description: Google's open-source framework that turns natural-language instructions into reliable Android automation: cross-app task execution, multimodal targeting, and Flash (fast reactive) / Pro (multi-agent planning) execution modes. Ships a Web UI console, MCP server, Python SDK, and CLI for integration with Claude Code, Codex and other agents. More Info

en.name: OpenClaw
en.description: Open-source, self-hosted AI agent that runs locally and autonomously executes tasks. Connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord and more, with browser control, system access, and persistent memory. Now maintained by the independent OpenClaw Foundation with OpenAI support; one of the fastest-growing open-source projects.

en.name: OpenWorker
en.description: Open-source, local-first desktop AI coworker by Andrew Ng. Delivers finished work (documents, Slack replies, calendar updates, reports) rather than chat answers. Supports 25+ app connectors, MCP, and bring-your-own-key models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Ollama, etc.) with local storage of data and credentials.

en.name: autoresearch
en.description: An autonomous AI agent for machine learning research by Karpathy. It can formulate hypotheses, modify training code, run experiments, and evaluate results autonomously to find performance improvements.

en.name: ml-intern
en.description: An open-source, autonomous AI agent by Hugging Face designed to function as a specialized Machine Learning Engineer. It handles the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including researching papers, writing code, running experiments, and shipping models to the Hugging Face Hub.

en.name: Multica
en.description: Open-source managed agents platform to integrate AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Gemini, Pi, Kimi, Kiro CLI, and more) into dev teams as first-class teammates. Features task assignment, progress tracking, reusable skills, and local daemon auto-detection of installed agent CLIs.

en.name: Paperclip
en.description: Open-source AI agent orchestration platform that models AI operations as a company. Define org charts, reporting lines, budgets, and governance policies, then let agents work autonomously within that structure. Supports OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, and other agent backends. Heartbeat-based execution with cost controls and audit trails.

en.name: Symphony
en.description: OpenAI's open-source project-to-delivery harness. Turns project requirements into isolated, autonomous implementation runs; agents monitor boards like Linear, open PRs, and merge code with proof-of-work (CI status, review feedback, demo videos). Currently in engineering preview.

en.name: QM
en.description: YC open-source multi-agent harness for organizations. Runs on Slack and Web with scoped workspaces (memory, files, credentials, permissions) per employee/project/channel; headless core with replaceable models/harnesses and self-hostable via Docker/Fly/AWS.

en.name: Buzz
en.description: Open-source, self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms. Agents get their own keys and audit trail to open repos, send patches, review code, run workflows, edit canvases, and join voice huddles. Built on a Nostr relay so every message and action is a signed event.

en.name: deer-flow
en.description: ByteDance's open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness. Orchestrates sub-agents, memory, sandboxes, tools, skills, and message gateways to research, code, and create. Built on LangGraph/LangChain with a web UI and multi-provider LLM support.

en.name: Orkas
en.description: Open-source, local-first multi-agent AI desktop client. A Commander decomposes goals and coordinates specialist agents in parallel or sequence, with private skills and memory. Supports BYO model providers and local model endpoints, and can drive Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, OpenCode, and Hermes. Cross-platform (macOS / Windows / Linux).

en.name: Orca
en.description: Cross-platform Agent Development Environment (ADE) for orchestrating fleets of parallel AI coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and any CLI agent side-by-side in isolated git worktrees, compare outputs, and merge the winner. Features mobile companion, terminal splits, Design Mode for capturing Chromium UI elements, GitHub/Linear integration, SSH worktrees, AI diff annotations, and Computer Use.

en.name: Paseo
en.description: 🌱 Open-source agentic development environment that unifies Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, Pi, Antigravity, and Muse Code in one interface. Runs parallel agents in isolated worktrees with built-in orchestration, editor, terminals, diffs, PRs, browser, and a plugin system. Self-hosted, privacy-first, cross-platform desktop/mobile/web/CLI, plus a TypeScript SDK. More Info

en.name: AgentsMesh
en.description: The AI Agent Workforce Platform. Self-hostable remote AI workstations (AgentPods) with PTY sandbox + git worktree isolation, multi-agent collaboration via channels and pod bindings, built-in Kanban with MR/PR integration, per-pod MCP server. Supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Aider, OpenCode.

en.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
en.description: Microsoft's MIT-licensed framework for production AI agents and multi-agent workflows, and the recommended successor to archived AutoGen. Supports Python and .NET, multiple model providers, graph-based orchestration, checkpointing, human approval, and OpenTelemetry observability. Suitable for teams that need durable, inspectable workflows from local development to cloud deployment; model and hosting costs depend on the chosen services.

en.name: msitarzewski/agency-agents
en.description: Open-source AI agency toolkit with 230+ specialized agent personas across engineering, design, marketing, sales, finance, game dev, healthcare, and more. Features ready-to-use agent personalities, workflow templates, deliverables, and a native desktop app to browse/install agents into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Kimi Code, Aider, and other AI dev tools.

en.name: ECC
en.description: Open-source enhancement framework for AI coding agents. Unified agent/skills/rules/Hooks/MCP configuration across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Zed, GitHub Copilot. Ships with 60 sub-agents, 232 skills, persistent memory, AgentShield security scan, and desktop dashboard GUI.

en.name: CC Switch
en.description: Cross-platform desktop app to manage Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and OpenClaw. Features visual configuration for API providers, MCP servers, and skills with bidirectional sync.

en.name: codex-plugin-cc
en.description: Claude Code plugin that enables using OpenAI Codex for code reviews and task delegation directly within Claude Code workflow. Provides /codex:review, /codex:adversarial-review and other commands

en.name: codesight
en.description: CLI token optimizer and AI context generator with built-in MCP server. Scans codebases to extract routes, schema, components, and dependencies, reducing AI context tokens by 9x–13x. Profiles for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, and Windsurf. Zero runtime dependencies.

en.name: AGENTS.md
en.description: An open standard for codebase documentation designed specifically for AI coding agents. Provides structured context, instructions, and constraints to help agents work more effectively and safely.

en.name: Spec Kit
en.description: GitHub's open-source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Provides the specify CLI and slash commands (/speckit.specify, /speckit.plan, /speckit.implement, etc.) that integrate with 30+ AI coding agents to turn specifications into executable implementation plans.

en.name: musistudio/claude-code-router
en.description: A powerful tool to route Claude Code requests to different models and customize any request. Supports multi-provider routing, request/response transformation, dynamic model switching, CLI model management, and GitHub Actions integration.

en.name: ultraworkers/claw-code
en.description: Rust reimplementation of Anthropic's Claude Code agent harness, now renamed agent-code (the claw-code crate on crates.io is a deprecated stub that only prints a rename notice). Maintained autonomously by agents as a showcase project; for production use the maintainers recommend LazyCodex or Gajae-Code. Focuses on building a better tool harness for AI agents with legal/ethical reimplementation

en.name: MemPalace
en.description: Open-source AI memory system that stores full conversations and project data locally without cloud dependencies. Organizes memories into a hierarchical "palace" structure, achieves 96.6% recall on LongMemEval — the highest published score for a fully local setup that calls no APIs, supports MCP integration and works offline with local LLMs.

en.name: TencentDB Agent Memory
en.description: Tencent Cloud's open-source memory infrastructure for agent teams. Provides Memory Hub for cross-session/cross-agent memory sharing, Chat Memory with L0–L3 distillation, Skill library for reusable expertise, and Wiki/CodeGraph for docs/code knowledge maps. Works with Claude Code, CodeBuddy, and other agents.

en.name: Hermes Agent
en.description: Open-source agentic framework built by NousResearch, fine-tuned on Hermes models with strong tool calling and reasoning capabilities for building autonomous AI agents.

en.name: Screenpipe
en.description: Searchable screen-text and audio history for recall, meeting notes, and work summaries via MCP or a local API. Raw history stays local by default; configured cloud AI, transcription, sync, and integrations can process context off-device. Source-available under the Screenpipe Commercial License. macOS, Windows, and Linux.

en.name: MastraAI
en.description: Mastra is an opinionated TypeScript framework that helps you build AI applications and features quickly. It gives you the set of primitives you need: workflows, agents, RAG, integrations and evals

en.name: FlowGram.AI
en.description: An extensible visual AI workflow development framework with built-in canvas, form engine, variable scope chain, and ready-to-use materials (LLM, Condition, Code Editor, etc.) for building AI workflow platforms faster.

en.name: Conductor
en.description: Netflix-originated open-source durable workflow engine now focused on AI agent orchestration. Provides event-driven execution, durable state, retries/timeouts, 14+ LLM providers, MCP tool calling, function calling, human-in-the-loop approval, and vector DB integration for RAG. Trusted in production at Netflix, Tesla, LinkedIn, and J.P. Morgan.

en.name: DeepTutor
en.description: An agent-native learning workspace by HKUDS that unifies AI tutoring, problem solving, quiz generation, research, visualization, and mastery practice. Features multi-engine RAG, persistent memory, Partners/My Agents, and live coding CLI integration.

en.name: potpie-ai/potpie
en.description: Open Source AI Agents for your codebase in minutes. Use pre-built agents for Q&A, Testing, Debugging and System Design or create your own purpose-built agents.

en.name: agentscope
en.description: Agent-Oriented Programming for Building LLM Applications, Open-sourced by Alibaba

en.name: Auto-GPT
en.description: Open source, An experimental open-source attempt to make GPT-4 fully autonomous. Now split into the hosted commercial AutoGPT Platform (Polyform Shield, paid) and the classic/ tree (original CLI, Forge, benchmarks — MIT, security fixes only, no new features).

en.name: CLI-Anything
en.description: An open-source framework that makes all software agent-native — auto-generates production-ready CLIs for any application via a 7-phase pipeline, enabling AI agents to control any desktop software. Supports 16+ AI agent platforms including Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex and includes CLI-Hub for community CLI discovery.

en.name: Understand Anything
en.description: AI-powered codebase and knowledge base analysis tool that builds interactive visual knowledge graphs. Features multi-agent analysis, architecture guided tours, and semantic search for large codebases. Works as a plugin for Claude Code, Cursor, and more.

en.name: Kortix
en.description: The open-source AI Management System — run a company's agent workforce with agents, skills, memory and 3,000+ connectors as files in one git repo you own; each session boots its own isolated Linux machine, and work lands through a human-reviewed change request. Self-host or managed cloud, any model with your own keys.

en.name: anthropics/skills
en.description: Official skills repository for Claude Code skills, providing reusable tool integrations and extensions for Claude Code AI assistant

en.name: openai/skills
en.description: Official skills repository for OpenAI GPT models, providing reusable tools and extensions for OpenAI's AI assistants

en.name: skills.sh
en.description: Community-driven skills registry and marketplace for AI assistants, providing a curated collection of reusable skills for various AI platforms including Claude Code, OpenAI GPT, and other LLM assistants, with download usage statistics and trending popularity rankings for all skills

en.name: BrowserAct Skills
en.description: Directory of reusable AI-agent skills and browser automation workflows for research, ecommerce, social/search extraction, video platforms, maps, and operational automation.

en.name: JimLiu/baoyu-skills
en.description: Community skills repository for Claude Code, providing practical Chinese-language and region-specific skills including Weibo posting functionality

en.name: ClawHub
en.description: A fast skill registry for AI agents, with vector search capabilities. Provides a centralized platform for managing and discovering agent skills.

en.name: garrytan/gstack
en.description: An opinionated collection of Claude Code skills that transform the AI agent into a specialized team of experts (CEO, PM, QA, DevOps). Adds custom slash commands and automated quality checks.

en.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
en.description: A curated library of 20+ engineering workflow skills for AI coding assistants. Standardizes the software development lifecycle from requirements through shipping, with 7 built-in commands: /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /ship, etc. Built by Google Gemini team lead Addy Osmani. Compatible with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and Cursor.

en.name: phuryn/pm-skills
en.description: Product-management skills marketplace for Claude Code and Claude Cowork, providing PM skills and chained workflows across discovery, strategy, execution, launch, growth, and shipping AI-built code.

en.name: NVIDIA/SkillSpector
en.description: Open-source security scanner for AI agent skills from NVIDIA. Scans skills (from Git repos, URLs, zip files, or directories) for risky patterns including prompt injection, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, malicious code, supply-chain issues, and MCP tool poisoning. Uses static analysis plus optional LLM-based semantic review and can be used in CI/CD or as an MCP server.

en.name: Superpowers
en.description: A complete software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills. Enforces spec-driven design, TDD, systematic debugging, code review, and subagent-driven development across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, OpenCode, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Pi.

en.name: last30days-skill
en.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, GitHub, arXiv, and the web, then synthesizes a grounded summary scored by real engagement. Supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and 50+ Agent Skills hosts.

en.name: webcmd
en.description: Browser skills for AI agents: learns how a site is navigated once, then compiles it into deterministic per-site CLI commands. Installs into Claude Code, Codex, and other hosts via webcmd skills add.

en.name: SemiAnalysis
en.description: Independent research on semiconductors, AI hardware, and the compute supply chain (founded by Dylan Patel, 2020). Builds proprietary data models — Accelerator/HBM, datacenter models, ClusterMAX GPU-cloud ratings, and the open-source InferenceX benchmark (called out by Jensen Huang at GTC 2026) — alongside long-form industry reports (some free, most subscription). More Info

en.name: World Monitor
en.description: AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard with 435+ curated feeds, geopolitical monitoring, infrastructure tracking, AI summaries, 21 languages support, local AI runtime and cross-platform native desktop apps

en.name: Prismix
en.description: AI hub aggregating real-time status of 75+ AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Cursor, etc.), curated news from 55+ AI sources with a personalized feed, and 500+ MCP server directory with bundles. Email/webhook alerts on outages.

en.name: AI Weekly
en.description: Independent AI news newsletter, 3x/week since 2015, read by 44,000+ professionals. The few AI stories that matter, solo-edited. Proprietary AI Weekly Index, quarterly State-of-AI recap, Who's-Who-of-AI graph (2,335 figures), and an 11-year archive.

en.name: ArtificialWatch
en.description: Alerts the minute a new AI model is released, across labs. Sweeps provider APIs every 60 seconds and fires only when a model answers a real API request; a public track record logs first-seen and confirmed times. Free email + push; paid SMS and phone call.

en.name: Cursor
en.description: The leading AI coding editor: switch between OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok and Cursor's own Composer models, and run parallel agents across desktop, CLI, Slack and GitHub. A wholly owned SpaceX (SpaceXAI) subsidiary since Aug 2026. More Info

en.name: GitHub Copilot
en.description: GitHub's code writing assistant, now a multi-vendor model picker (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and more) chosen per task

en.name: Bolt.new
en.description: StackBlitz's browser-based AI full-stack app builder — describe an app in plain language and the AI agent scaffolds, runs, and deploys it in the browser via WebContainers (real Node.js at near-native speed, no local setup or cloud VM). Free / Pro $25/mo / Teams $30 per member / Enterprise plans; open-source sibling bolt.diy supports bring-your-own-key. One of the fastest-growing dev tools ($40M ARR within 5 months of launch; Microsoft Azure partnership since May 2026).

en.name: OpenCode
en.description: Open-source terminal-native AI coding agent. Provider-agnostic (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, local models), with a TUI client/server architecture, LSP integration, and support for custom agents and MCP servers.

en.name: OpenChamber
en.description: Desktop and web GUI for the OpenCode AI agent. Provides session management, diffs, and workspace control on top of OpenCode.

en.name: oh-my-pi
en.description: Fork of Pi by @can1357. A terminal-native AI coding agent with the IDE wired in: LSP, DAP debugging, Python/Bun code execution, 40+ providers, and 32 built-in tools.

en.name: mu
en.description: Open-source (MIT) coding agent built on Pi, with a CLI and a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux (the app is based on AionUi, Apache-2.0). It adds a judgment kernel: at more than 30 decision points a small, fast judge model (Jev by default; a local 322M judge, a classifier or any LLM can take a point instead) makes the routine calls, such as which chunks of a long tool output enter the context, whether a rule-flagged command was asked for, and whether a fetched page or MCP result carries instructions aimed at the model, so the main model keeps its attention for the work.

en.name: dbForge AI Assistant
en.description: AI-powered tool that generates, optimizes, and troubleshoots SQL code; indispensable for developers, DBAs, and analysts

en.name: Happy Coder
en.description: Mobile and Web client for Codex and Claude Code, with realtime voice, encryption and fully featured

en.name: Trae
en.description: ByteDance's AI coding IDE built around agentic programming: AI Q&A, code auto-completion, and autonomous multi-step coding tasks.

en.name: scalene
en.description: Scalene: a high-performance, high-precision CPU, GPU, and memory profiler for Python with AI-powered optimization proposals

en.name: git-lrc
en.description: Free, Unlimited AI Code Reviews That Run on Every Commit

en.name: alibaba/open-code-review
en.description: Open-source AI code-review CLI/agent by Alibaba. Reviews Git diffs with deterministic pipelines plus an LLM agent, supports line-level comments, configurable OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, custom rules, JSON CI output, WebUI session viewer, and Claude Code/Codex integrations.

en.name: Kodus
en.description: Open Source Code Review Agent

en.name: Steel Browser
en.description: Open-source browser sandbox and automation infrastructure for AI agents and apps with session-backed workflows, screenshots, PDFs, proxies, and anti-bot tooling.

en.name: Termux

en.name: Markstream

en.name: Cortex
en.description: Open-source CLI that generates interactive API documentation, typed SDKs, and MCP servers from OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC, OpenRPC, and Markdown.

en.name: REA

The agent inspects a target feature without source code, receives evidence-backed findings, and reconstructs a working implementation for your project. More Info

en.name: PentAGI

en.name: Codex Security

It also drafts a SECURITY.md policy, scores and deduplicates findings against your own rubric with owners inferred from Git history, exports SARIF/JSON/CSV and publishes to Linear. Runs across repositories, in CI and in containers. Free; needs an OpenAI API key or sign-in.

en.name: VibeVoice
en.description: Open-source voice AI framework from Microsoft. Microsoft removed the TTS code on Sep 5, 2025 over misuse concerns (online generation for TTS-1.5B is disabled), so the mainline is now ASR. ASR supports 60-minute long-form audio with speaker diarization and 50+ languages; TTS generates natural long-form multi-speaker or real-time streaming speech.

en.name: Voicebox
en.description: Open-source, local-first AI voice studio (a self-hosted alternative to ElevenLabs + WisprFlow). Combines voice cloning, speech generation (multiple TTS engines, 23 languages), Whisper-based dictation/transcription, and a local LLM for text refinement. Ships an MCP server so agents like Claude Code or Cursor can speak in cloned voices. All models and voice data stay on your machine; runs on macOS/Windows/Linux/Docker with GPU acceleration.

en.name: VoiceStudio
en.description: Open-source, local-first AI voice workbench (an ElevenLabs alternative): zero-shot voice cloning (3–15s samples), video dubbing, dictation/transcription, and audiobook production across 646 languages. No account or API key required; models and audio stay on your machine; a local OpenAI-compatible API and MCP server work with Claude Desktop and Cursor. Note: AGPL-3.0, default engine weights CC-BY-NC, output watermarked.

en.name: speech-to-speech
en.description: Low-latency, fully modular voice-agent pipeline (VAD → STT → LLM → TTS) from Hugging Face. Exposes an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket API; every component is swappable, supporting fully local or API-backed deployment. Used in production as the conversation backend for Reachy Mini robots.

en.name: Grok Voice 3.0
en.description: xAI's real-time speech-to-speech model for conversational agents and customer-support calls. Supports natural turn-taking, interruptions, multilingual conversation, and tool-driven workflows, with company-reported first-audio latency below one second. Available through the Voice Agent API; grok-voice-latest points to the current version. Billed at $0.08/minute; model quality and task costs depend on the workload.

en.name: vocalremover
en.description: Extract vocal and music

en.name: lala.ai
en.description: Extract vocal, accompaniment and various instruments from any audio and video

en.name: suno.ai
en.description: The AI music creation tool Suno can generate custom songs based on text prompts in mere seconds. Current generation Suno v6 — the first family trained on licensed catalogs from Warner, BMG and Believe, with revenue sharing.

en.name: udio
en.description: AI music platform that pivoted from instant song generation to licensed remixing and a creator community after settling with UMG, Warner, Merlin, and Kobalt (Sony's suit continues). Note: audio, video, and stem downloads have been disabled for all tiers since late Oct 2025.

en.name: mureka.ai
en.description: AI music creation tool by Kunlun Wanwei. Current flagship Mureka V9.5; the more advanced O3 has been previewed but not yet released.

en.name: elevenlabs/sound-effects
en.description: Imagine a sound and bring it to life, or explore a selection of the best sound effects generated by the community.

en.name: audiocraft
en.description: Meta's open-source audio/music generation library with two models: MusicGen (text-to-music) and AudioGen (text-to-sound). Unmaintained since early 2025; code is MIT, model weights CC-BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial). MusicGen Online Demo

en.name: Stable Audio
en.description: AI music and sound-effect generation by Stability AI — full-length tracks and SFX from text prompts. Current generation Stable Audio 3.0 (released May 20, 2026).

en.name: OptimizerAI
en.description: Sound effect generation. Official Introduction

en.name: SFX Engine
en.description: AI Sound effect generation.

en.name: Claude Video
en.description: Open-source tool that lets AI agents watch and summarize videos. Extracts frames, transcripts/captions from YouTube, TikTok, or local files and answers questions grounded in both visual and audio content. Works with Claude Code and 50+ agent hosts.

en.name: Lean 4
en.description: An interactive theorem prover and functional programming language, serving as the core infrastructure for formal AI research and automated theorem proving (e.g., AlphaProof, DeepSeek-Prover).

en.name: AMiner
en.description: AI-powered academic research and tech intelligence platform providing paper search, patent search, literature tracking, and scholar profiling

en.name: alphaxiv
en.description: An open academic discussion community based on the arXiv platform that allows users to comment line-by-line, ask questions, and interact in real-time by replacing the paper's linking domain (arxiv.org for alphaxiv.org) directly on the paper's page. And provides AI features such as Ask AI and AI-generated article blogs

en.name: Umi-OCR
en.description: Comes with a highly efficient offline OCR engine. As long as the computer performance is sufficient, it can be faster than online OCR services.

en.name: light-ocr
en.description: Fast, offline OCR for Node.js and C++ with bundled PP-OCRv6 models and cross-platform runtimes.

en.name: allenai/olmocr
en.description: A toolkit for training language models to work with PDF documents in the wild. Online demo: https://olmocr.allenai.org/

en.name: SynthID Detector
en.description: Google DeepMind's official portal for verifying AI-generated media — expanded in October 2026 with OpenAI, NVIDIA and Kakao (Apple joining soon) into a cross-vendor coalition for content provenance. Upload images, audio, video or text to check for SynthID invisible watermarks; partial matches highlight the watermarked region. Watermarks are embedded in pixels/waveforms rather than metadata, surviving screenshots, compression and crops. Detects watermark-carrying content only — not a generic AI-content detector. Free, available globally in English.

en.name: Content Credentials Verify
en.description: Free C2PA provenance inspector from the Content Authenticity Initiative. Displays signed Content Credentials, including available creator, tool, editing-history, and AI-generation disclosures, and helps inspect whether credentials validate. Results depend on the credentials attached to the file: missing credentials do not establish whether media is human-made or AI-generated, and valid credentials do not prove the depicted claim is true.

en.name: Figure 03
en.description: Figure AI's third-generation humanoid robot, powered by the in-house Helix vision-language-action model. The company raised over $1B in Series C funding in 2025 at a $39B valuation; F.03 is ramping into mass production and deployed at BMW factories.

en.description: Boston Dynamics' new all-electric humanoid robot

en.description: Tesla's humanoid robot

en.description: Apptronik's humanoid robot, now iterated to Apollo 2, with partners including Google DeepMind, NVIDIA, Mercedes-Benz, and GXO, focused on logistics and manufacturing.

en.name: Digit

en.description: Sanctuary AI's humanoid robot, known for its hydraulic dexterous hands; in 2026 the company shifted its strategy toward providing Physical AI software for other robotics platforms and expanded into industrial robotics.

en.name: MenteeBot
en.description: The first bipedal humanoid robot by Israel's Mentee Robotics (acquired by Mobileye in Jan 2026).

en.name: Genesis World
en.description: Now renamed Genesis World (v1.0 released May 2026, maintained by Genesis AI). High-performance simulation platform for general-purpose robotics and embodied AI: a unified multi-physics engine, the Nyx photo-realistic renderer and the Quadrants compiler for training AI agents in complex physical worlds.
